entries.value: "Component-library store (SQLite stores at ~/.base-studio-code/components.db + kits.db) for base-studio-code (#2281) — the proven-component kits the pane, planner, and every live session share, a thin two-collection shim over the shared bsc-json-store (#2158), reachable from the Tauri app's component bridge and the session-facing `bsc ui` CLI (#2469 — its store verbs mount under `bsc ui`)."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# The core lib (no Tauri, no SQLite) so the tiny CLI reuses it without dragging the whole desktop app
# in. The hyphenated package name maps to the `bsc_component` crate name.

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# Runtime attestations (#doctor-reads-the-runtime) - the --runtime lens reads what the app OBSERVED
# while running. The ANALYSIS lives there, beside the data, so bsc graph doctor asks the same question
# of the same rows; only the presentation is here.
# The shared verbatim-JSON-per-id store + CLI scaffold (#2158) — this crate supplies only the two
# Shared CLI scaffold (#1762): `CmdDoc` for the per-command help catalog.
# The `eslint-preset` generator reads each stored component's JSON + emits the eslint config (#2279).
# The versioned sound-kit release store (#3412) — `bsc ui doctor --sound-kit` reads a PINNED kit's
# artifact so `@bsc/sounds/…` is judged against the kit the project adopted, matching the frontend.
# The ALGORITHMS store (materialize-a-records-record-closure) — a test materialization resolves a
# record's imports the way the running app does, and the last link in that chain is an algorithm impl
# whose `provides` is the specifier (a logic module authored as a record). Read-only, and one-way:
